## Problem

What operator need or gap does this address?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like ServerLens to do.

## Scope & boundaries

ServerLens is **local-first and defensive-only**. Please confirm the request
fits that scope — it should not require offensive scanning, credential
guessing, source attribution/enrichment, remote modification, or outbound
calls that are on by default.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or alternative approaches you've thought about.
